Build is clean now (exit 0). Two real bugs from the bundler bump, both in the link stage:

- `src/core/options.js:6` — still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`, so it threw on `undefined.toFixed()`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:8` — the strict boolean check threw when the flag was `undefined` (the new config loader's way of saying "unset"); now it treats `undefined` as `false`, same as before.

The remaining 8 warnings are just the deprecation/lint noise baked into the bundler output — not blocking anything.
